scripts.build: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/api && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.operator.jsonc --dry-run --outdir dist/operator
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run access:test && pnpm run inventory:check && pnpm run types:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.format: oxfmt --write src test scripts operator-ui operator-app README.md vitest.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.operator.jsonc wrangler.operator-bootstrap.jsonc package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check src test scripts operator-ui operator-app README.md vitest.config.ts wrangler.jsonc wrangler.operator.jsonc wrangler.operator-bootstrap.jsonc package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml
